notes: 2026-11-20 review pass by reviewer: No blocking defect. Checked: every parallel Go test vs process-wide writes (slog default, http.DefaultTransport, chain.EthUSD, reauth.TwoStepWait stay in sequential tests with Cleanup restore; removed signedInAt write was the only shared var); go test -race -count=3 -shuffle=on on httpapi/tests, settlement, ledger, database passes; backend e2e -count=2 -shuffle passes; harness 67 tests and docs-check pass. Lanes: cache writes under lock, done/errors safe, lane exception propagates and stops other lanes (tried), SIGTERM/Ctrl-C stop every RUNNING check, cmd_verify fails when a lane stops early (len(results) < len(order)). CI matrix [main, unit] covers all required and CI-only checks; artifact names unique. Non-blocking: (1) docs/workflow.md:73 says Go and forge checks share the unit lane, but backend-e2e and e2e (Go e2e reading packages/contracts/out) and build (forge build via turbo) are main lane; a local check --ci without --lane, or an explicit symbolic task check, can run forge clean while backend e2e reads out/ and fail spuriously; CI jobs are separate so CI is safe. Concurrent forge compiles showed no torn artifact reads in 3 trials. (2) verification.run: a lane thread that passed cancelled.is_set() just before stop_running() can still start one check that outlives the harness; tiny window. (3) signedInAt is now fixed at process start: fresh-sign-in tests need the httpapi/tests process to finish within auth.FreshWindow (15 min); now about 66 s. (4) e2e freeAddr reserves then closes a port; with parallel stacks a reused port would let waitFor(api healthy) reach another test's API; low odds. (5) The CI Postgres restart step is only actionlint-checked until a staging run.

2026-11-20 review pass by reviewer: Re-review of changes since the last pass; no blocking defect. (1) e2e/gate_test.go apiStart mutex: freeAddr through /healthz runs under the lock, and defer Unlock covers t.Fatal; the only other freeAddr caller is the sequential loadtest. (2) docs/workflow.md lane bullets match config.json. Nit: backend-e2e also reads the contracts build, not only e2e. (3) chain/budget_test: rates give api next_at about now+6.25 s and money about now+0.4 s. The order check catches a shared bucket (no row) and a too-small money share, and drops only the 200 ms wall-clock bound. (4) pay.spec.ts reads the three rects in one evaluate: 10/10 with --repeat-each=10; tsc and biome clean. (5) PayerEmailAllRate var: routes.go reads it once when the router is built, the test is sequential with a Cleanup restore, and mid.Buckets handles rate 0 (as DryQuoteAllRate already does). (6) TestUserRateLimit with burst 3 still checks 429, rate_limited, Retry-After 1, per-user buckets and refill. It no longer asserts the default 60 or the 0->mid.UserBurst fallback in guards.go:27: a small, acceptable loss. Ran: go test -race -count=3 -shuffle=on ./internal/chain ./internal/httpapi/tests ok; the two rate tests with -count=5 ok; e2e -count=2 -shuffle ok; harness tests and docs-check ok.
